# Altibase GPTs Image Inventory

Job: `JOB-013`
Phase: P1 Inventory
Status: Complete

Objective: list candidate images in the selected source documents and classify them for Mermaid or text conversion.

## Scope and Method

- Source list: `GPTs/reports/source_inventory.md`
- Selected Markdown source documents scanned: 114
- Source documents containing image references: 102
- Source documents without image references: 12
- Image references classified: 3513
- Match patterns: Markdown image links and quoted HTML `<img src="...">` references.
- The report keeps source paths for traceability. Customer-facing attachment work should use customer-safe labels such as "Altibase 8.1 verified source" and should not copy internal source labels into `GPTs/attachments/`.

Every matched image reference has a non-empty class, conversion action, and priority in the full inventory section below. Images that are not useful conversion candidates, such as logos and repeated syntax legend icons, are still classified so later jobs can omit them intentionally.

## Classification Rules

| Class | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| Syntax diagram -> BNF text | Convert SQL, PSM, command, and data type syntax railroads to compact BNF-like text. Use Mermaid only if a diagram has meaningful branching that is clearer visually. |
| Architecture/topology -> Mermaid | Convert component, storage, network, process, and topology diagrams to Mermaid flowcharts when the relationships matter. |
| Flow/state/sequence -> Mermaid | Convert workflow, failover, recovery, checkpoint, replication, state, and ordered process diagrams to Mermaid flowcharts, state diagrams, or sequence diagrams. |
| Execution plan tree -> text/Mermaid | Prefer an indented textual plan tree for query plans; use Mermaid for essential parent-child examples only. |
| UI screenshot -> procedural text | Replace screenshots with menu paths, input fields, selected values, and expected outcomes. |
| Screenshot/config table -> text | Transcribe configuration, mapping, code, or result screenshots as concise text blocks or item blocks. |
| Table/visual list -> searchable blocks | Decompose visual tables, mapping charts, and compatibility lists into searchable item blocks. |
| Reference figure -> text summary | Summarize residual conceptual figures in one or two source-backed sentences unless later review finds visual-only detail. |
| Syntax legend icon | Do not convert every repeated icon. Replace once with shared text explaining mandatory, optional, choice, and repeat notation. |
| Boilerplate/logo | Omit from attachment content. |
